title: Fall $$2023$$ Midterm
body: Selected questions from the Fall $$2023$$ Midterm. Q5(c): Rohan brings in a new variable $$z_i$$ to predict $$y_i$$ for $$i\in\{1, \dots, n\}\$\$;$$ $$a$$ $$scatterplot$$ $$of$$ $$z_i$$ vs $$y_i$$ is provided. The scatterplot of $$y_i$$ against $$z_i$$ curves upward, rising slowly at first and then steeply to about $$300$$ at $$z_i=10$$. $$Q6$$: $$Tina$$ $$wants$$ $$to$$ $$use$$ $$OLS$$ $$to$$ $$predict$$ $$a$$ $$person's$$ $$height$$, $$stored$$ $$in$$ $$a$$ $$vector$$ $$Y$$. $$She$$ $$makes$$ $$use$$ $$of$$ $$an$$ $$m$$ by $$n$$ design matrix $$X$$, $$which$$ $$contains$$ $$m$$ rows and $$n$$ columns, including a column representing the intercept. Assume that $$X$$ and $$Y$$ meet all the requirements for OLS.
